_about: Copy to vendor_data.json (git-ignored) and point each entry at your own files to run the vendor-agreement tests. Missing entries skip their test.
g_band_map: a LabSpec .l6m map fitted in Q-Carbon
g_band_export: Q-Carbon's exported result table for that map (G columns 1-3)
error_pair_error: Q-Carbon's ERROR.l6i result image for it
error_pair_g_area: Q-Carbon's G area result image (.l6i) for it
error_pair_d3_area: Q-Carbon's D3 area result image (.l6i) for it
screenshot_map: a 97 x 92 .l6m map (with its .l6v next to it)
screenshot_png: LabSpec's own screenshot of that map (red map panel)
text_export: a map exported by LabSpec as a text matrix
